text:
erin: Heads-up - BlueHarbor (seed logistics/retail startup) ran out of starter credits. They want a 4-week POC and asked if we can bump credits to $4k so they can validate embeddings + reranker at production-ish scale.

maria: What's their token estimate and acceptance criteria? We need to map to startup tier.

erin: They estimate ~40k tokens/week, goal is embedding recall parity and reranker precision > 85% on our eval set. No ARR commit yet.

sam: Security asked if they'll need VPC. If they do, free credits off the table.

nina: We can offer an IP allowlist sandbox + ephemeral keys and share SOC2 extract and abbreviated questionnaire. If they insist on VPC, escalate to Private pilot pricing.

deal-desk: Standard startup credit is $3k. Proposal: approve a one-time $4k hosted credit. Add a conversion incentive: if they sign a 6-month reserved commit within 60 days, match 25% of used credits (cap $5k) as invoice credit. Require AE to get MOU signed.

erin: Can we add a short PR/case study ask? Theyre open to doing a customer quote.

deal-desk: Acceptable as consideration. Condition: PR must be mutually agreed.

ops: I can provision the sandbox with IP allowlist and 30-day ephemeral keys. Will post the curl snippet.

maria: Logging exception in tracker: "BlueHarbor trial exception: $4k hosted credit, 25% conversion match cap $5k, sandbox IP allowlist, SOC2 extract shared." AE to attach MOU to CRM.

erin: I'll send the MOU and the security questionnaire. I'll also ask them to confirm dates; they asked for an 6-week window due to internal timelines.

deal-desk: One-time extension to 6 weeks approved. Update MOU.

erin: BlueHarbor accepted sandbox and MOU today. Thanks team.

maria: Closing loop once we see first API calls. Tag me in CRM.

erin: Will do. :rocket:
